<profile>
Sells: Fernhill Coffee Supply sells home coffee brewing equipment and coffee beans. The range covers pour-over gear (ceramic and stainless steel drippers, size 02 paper filters, stovetop and electric gooseneck kettles, and a brew scale with timer), immersion brewers such as a French press and a cold brew jar, and manual and electric burr grinders. It also sells single-origin coffee beans from Fernhill Roastery in 250 g and 1 kg bags, whole bean or ground.
Audience: People who brew coffee at home, especially by pour-over or immersion, and who want to grind, weigh and control water temperature themselves. Some products, such as the single-dose flat-burr grinder and the temperature-hold kettle, suit buyers who care about precise brewing.
Country: GB
Tone: expert
Never say: —
</profile>

<products>
<group name="Coffee beans">
  P1: Ethiopia Guji, natural process
    - Ethiopia Guji, natural process is coffee beans.
    - Ethiopia Guji, natural process is sold by Fernhill Roastery.
    - Ethiopia Guji, natural process is available in 250 g and 1 kg sizes.
    - Ethiopia Guji, natural process is available as whole bean, filter grind, or espresso grind.
    - Ethiopia Guji, natural process is a single origin coffee.
    - Ethiopia Guji, natural process is grown at 1,900–2,100 m in the Guji zone.
    - Ethiopia Guji, natural process is grown by smallholders delivering to the Hambela washing station.
    - Ethiopia Guji, natural process is made from heirloom varieties.
    - Ethiopia Guji, natural process is natural processed and dried on raised beds for 21 days.
    - Ethiopia Guji, natural process is a light roast.
    - Ethiopia Guji, natural process has tasting notes of blueberry, dark chocolate and jasmine.
  P2: Colombia Huila, washed
    - The Colombia Huila coffee is washed-process.
    - The Colombia Huila product is coffee beans.
    - The Colombia Huila coffee is from Fernhill Roastery.
    - The Colombia Huila coffee comes in 250 g and 1 kg sizes.
    - The Colombia Huila coffee is single origin.
    - The Colombia Huila coffee comes from the Pitalito municipality in Huila.
    - The Colombia Huila coffee is grown at 1,600–1,800 m.
    - The Colombia Huila coffee is made from Caturra and Castillo varieties.
    - The Colombia Huila coffee is fully washed and fermented 36 hours.
    - The Colombia Huila coffee is a medium roast.
    - The Colombia Huila coffee is suited to both filter and espresso.
    - The Colombia Huila coffee has tasting notes of red apple, caramel, and milk chocolate.
</group>
<group name="Dripper">
  P3: Ceramic Cone Dripper, size 02
    - The Ceramic Cone Dripper is size 02.
    - The Ceramic Cone Dripper is a dripper.
    - The Ceramic Cone Dripper is made by Fernhill.
    - The Ceramic Cone Dripper comes in White and Matte black.
    - The Ceramic Cone Dripper is made of porcelain.
    - The Ceramic Cone Dripper is made from glazed porcelain fired in Arita, Japan.
    - The Ceramic Cone Dripper fits size 02 cone filters.
    - The Ceramic Cone Dripper brews 1 to 4 cups.
    - The Ceramic Cone Dripper has a single large outlet hole.
    - The Ceramic Cone Dripper has spiral ribs on the inner wall that leave room for air to escape.
    - The Ceramic Cone Dripper weighs 380 g.
    - The Ceramic Cone Dripper is dishwasher safe.
  P4: Flat-Bottom Dripper, stainless steel
    - The Flat-Bottom Dripper is made of stainless steel.
    - The Flat-Bottom Dripper is made by Fernhill.
    - The Flat-Bottom Dripper has a brushed 18/8 stainless steel body.
    - The Flat-Bottom Dripper has three small holes in a flat bed.
    - The Flat-Bottom Dripper takes 185-size wave filters.
    - The Flat-Bottom Dripper brews 1 to 2 cups (up to 500 ml).
    - The Flat-Bottom Dripper has a double wall.
    - The Flat-Bottom Dripper weighs 210 g.
</group>
<group name="Filter">
  P5: Paper Filters, size 02 (100 pack)
    - The Fernhill Paper Filters are size 02.
    - The Fernhill Paper Filters come in a pack of 100.
    - The Fernhill Paper Filters are available in Unbleached and White types.
    - The Fernhill Paper Filters are cone filters for size 02 drippers.
    - The Fernhill Paper Filters have an oxygen-whitened alternative available.
    - The Fernhill Paper Filters should be rinsed with hot water before brewing to remove paper taste.
    - The Fernhill Paper Filters are made by Fernhill.
</group>
<group name="Grinder">
  P6: Hand Grinder, conical steel burrs
    - The Fernhill Hand Grinder has conical steel burrs.
    - The Fernhill Hand Grinder is a manual grinder.
    - The Fernhill Hand Grinder has 38 mm hardened stainless steel conical burrs.
    - The Fernhill Hand Grinder has external click adjustment with 30 settings.
    - The Fernhill Hand Grinder's settings range from espresso to French press.
    - The Fernhill Hand Grinder holds 25 g of beans.
    - The Fernhill Hand Grinder has an aluminium body.
    - The Fernhill Hand Grinder weighs 520 g.
    - The Fernhill Hand Grinder grinds a 15 g dose for pour-over in about 40 seconds.
  P7: Electric Flat-Burr Grinder
    - The Electric Flat-Burr Grinder has 64 mm flat steel burrs.
    - The Electric Flat-Burr Grinder has stepless adjustment.
    - The Electric Flat-Burr Grinder has a single-dose design.
    - The Electric Flat-Burr Grinder has retention under 0.1 g.
    - The Electric Flat-Burr Grinder has a 250 W motor running at 1,400 rpm.
    - The Electric Flat-Burr Grinder has bellows on top to puff out remaining grounds.
    - The Electric Flat-Burr Grinder has a height of 38 cm.
    - The Electric Flat-Burr Grinder is made by Fernhill.
    - The Electric Flat-Burr Grinder is an electric grinder.
</group>
<group name="Immersion brewer">
  P8: French Press 1 litre
    - The French Press has a capacity of 1 litre.
    - The French Press is an immersion brewer.
    - The French Press is made by Fernhill.
    - The French Press has a borosilicate glass beaker.
    - The French Press beaker sits in a stainless steel frame.
    - The French Press makes about 4 mugs.
    - The French Press has a four-layer mesh filter.
    - All parts of the French Press come apart for cleaning.
    - The French Press beaker is replaceable.
  P9: Cold Brew Jar 1.5 litre
    - The Cold Brew Jar has a capacity of 1.5 litre.
    - The Cold Brew Jar is an immersion brewer.
    - The Cold Brew Jar is made by Fernhill.
    - The Cold Brew Jar is a glass jar.
    - The Cold Brew Jar has a fine stainless steel filter basket.
    - The Cold Brew Jar filter basket holds up to 150 g of coarse ground coffee.
    - The Cold Brew Jar makes 1.5 litres of concentrate.
    - The Cold Brew Jar has an airtight lid.
    - The Cold Brew Jar fits in a fridge door.
    - The recommended steep time for the Cold Brew Jar is 12 to 18 hours in the fridge.
</group>
<group name="Kettle">
  P10: Gooseneck Pour-Over Kettle 900 ml
    - The Fernhill Gooseneck Pour-Over Kettle has a capacity of 900 ml.
    - The Fernhill Gooseneck Pour-Over Kettle has a recommended fill of 600 ml.
    - The Fernhill Gooseneck Pour-Over Kettle has a spout opening of 8 mm.
    - The Fernhill Gooseneck Pour-Over Kettle has a built-in thermometer reading 40–100 °C.
    - The Fernhill Gooseneck Pour-Over Kettle is made of stainless steel.
    - The Fernhill Gooseneck Pour-Over Kettle works on gas, electric and induction hobs.
    - The Gooseneck Pour-Over Kettle is made by Fernhill.
  P11: Electric Gooseneck Kettle with Temperature Hold
    - The Electric Gooseneck Kettle with Temperature Hold lets you set the temperature in 1 °C steps from 60 to 100 °C.
    - The Electric Gooseneck Kettle with Temperature Hold base holds the set temperature for 60 minutes.
    - The Electric Gooseneck Kettle with Temperature Hold has an 800 ml capacity.
    - The Electric Gooseneck Kettle with Temperature Hold has a 1200 W heating element.
    - The Electric Gooseneck Kettle with Temperature Hold has a UK plug.
    - The Electric Gooseneck Kettle with Temperature Hold has a 75 cm base cable.
    - The Electric Gooseneck Kettle with Temperature Hold has a gooseneck spout.
    - The Electric Gooseneck Kettle with Temperature Hold is made by Fernhill.
</group>
<group name="Scale">
  P12: Brew Scale with Timer
    - The Brew Scale with Timer weighs up to 2 kg.
    - The Brew Scale with Timer weighs in 0.1 g steps.
    - The Brew Scale with Timer has a built-in timer that starts automatically when the first drops land.
    - The Brew Scale with Timer has a USB-C rechargeable battery.
    - The Brew Scale with Timer battery lasts about 30 hours per charge.
    - The Brew Scale with Timer has a silicone pad that protects against heat.
    - The Brew Scale with Timer measures 13 × 13 × 2.5 cm.
    - The Brew Scale with Timer is made by Fernhill.
</group>
</products>
